tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the supply and quality performances of the bidder are not satisfactory in respect of previous/past supplies, the offers of such firm will be dis-qualified.

The bidder shall be an ASRTU Rate Contract firm OR the manufacturer with an average annual turnover of Rs. 5.00 Crores for the preceding three years i.e., 2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-2025. For the Micro and Small Enterprises, the minimum average annual turnover shall be Rs. 75 lakhs during the preceding two years i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25 as detailed in the tender document.

The bidder shall submit the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing/Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for having the required financial turnover as detailed in the tender document.
The bidder shall submit the Annual GST return acknowledged by the concerned Tax Authority for having the required financial turnover as detailed in the tender document.

The bidder shall submit the Verification Certificate from the Chartered Accountant stating that the turnover details furnished in the audited statement of accounts have been verified by him and that they are found to be correct as a proof for having the required financial turn over as detailed in the tender document.
The bidder who wish to avail the benefits of MSME shall submit the Small Scale Industries Certificate if the bidder is a Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME).
The bidder must submit the valid NSIC Certificate to avail exemption from the payment of Earnest Money Deposit or else the full EMD amount must be paid through e-payment in the KPPP.
The bidder shall submit the duly filled out, sealed and signed Annexure-A, Annexure-A1, Additional Format, Environment Safety Data Sheet and Environmental Management System Checklist.
